settings.heading: Privacy Policy
settings.body: This policy explains what personal information GBG Wholesale Hub collects, why we collect it, who we share it with, and the rights you have over it under UK data protection law.

settings.heading: The information we hold
settings.body: We only collect what we need to sell to you and support you:

settings.text: Order details - your name, email, delivery address, phone number and what you bought.
Account details, if you create an account - your name, email and saved addresses.
Messages you send us through the contact form, the waitlist form or WhatsApp.
Marketing preferences - whether you've asked to hear about restocks and offers.
Technical and usage data collected by our website platform, such as your device type, approximate location and which pages you viewed.
We never see or store your full card details. Payments are handled entirely by Shopify's payment providers.

settings.heading: How your information is used, and our lawful basis
settings.body: We use your information to fulfil your order, to provide support, to meet our legal obligations, and - only where you've agreed - to send you marketing.

settings.text: To process and deliver your order, and to handle returns and refunds. Lawful basis: performance of our contract with you.
To answer your questions and provide customer support. Lawful basis: performance of our contract, or our legitimate interest in helping you.
To send restock alerts, offers and community updates. Lawful basis: your consent, which you can withdraw at any time.
To keep records required for tax and accounting. Lawful basis: our legal obligation.
To protect against fraud and keep the site secure. Lawful basis: our legitimate interest in running the business safely.
We do not sell your personal information to anyone, and we never will.

settings.heading: Who we share your information with
settings.body: We share only what is necessary, only with providers who need it to do their job for us:

settings.text: Shopify, which hosts this store and processes orders on our behalf.
Payment providers, who process your payment securely and hold the card details we never see.
Delivery carriers, who receive your name and address so your parcel can reach you.
Our email provider, where you've consented to marketing.
Professional advisers and authorities, where we are legally required to disclose information.
Some of these providers operate outside the UK. Where that happens, transfers are covered by the safeguards required under UK data protection law.

settings.heading: How long we keep it
settings.body: Order and transaction records are kept for six years, because tax law requires it. Account details are kept for as long as your account is open, plus a short period afterwards. Marketing contact details are kept until you unsubscribe. Support messages are kept for up to two years so we have context if you come back to us.

settings.heading: What you can ask us to do
settings.body: Under UK GDPR you have the right to:

settings.text: Ask for a copy of the personal information we hold about you.
Ask us to correct anything that's wrong or incomplete.
Ask us to delete your information, where we're not legally required to keep it.
Ask us to restrict or stop processing it, including objecting to marketing at any time.
Ask for your information in a portable format.
Withdraw consent at any time, without affecting anything done before you withdrew it.
Complain to the Information Commissioner's Office (ico.org.uk) if you think we've handled your data badly. We'd appreciate the chance to put it right first.

settings.heading: Cookies and tracking
settings.body:
This store uses cookies that are necessary for it to work - keeping you signed in, remembering what's in your cart, and keeping checkout secure. These cannot be switched off without breaking the site.

We also use analytics cookies to understand which pages people find useful. You can control non-essential cookies through your browser settings or the cookie preferences available on this store, and blocking them will not stop you shopping.

settings.heading: Want to see, correct or delete your data?
settings.body: Contact us and we'll respond within one month, as the law requires. Tell us which of the rights above you want to use.
